meta.fullName: Acquisition of Certain Area at Ayodhya Act, 1993

sections.title: Short title and commencement
sections.content:
(1) This Act may be called the Acquisition of Certain Area at Ayodhya Act, 1993.
(2) It shall be deemed to have come into force on the 7th day of January, 1993.

Preamble: Whereas there has been a long-standing dispute relating to the structure (including the premises of the inner and outer courtyards of such structure), commonly known as the Ram Janma Bhumi-Babri Masjid, situated in village Kot Ramchandra in Ayodhya, in Pargana Haveli Avadh, in tehsil Faizabad Sadar, in the district of Faizabad of the State of Uttar Pradesh; and whereas the said dispute has affected the maintenance of public order and harmony between different communities in the country; and whereas it is necessary to maintain public order and to promote communal harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood amongst the people of India; and whereas with a view to achieving the aforesaid objectives, it is necessary to acquire certain areas in Ayodhya.

sections.title: Definitions
Acquisition of rights in respect of certain area
sections.chapter: Chapter II - Acquisition of the Area in Ayodhya
sections.content: On and from the commencement of this Act, the right, title and interest in relation to the area shall, by virtue of this Act, stand transferred to, and vest in, the Central Government.

sections.title: General effect of vesting
sections.chapter: Chapter II - Acquisition of the Area in Ayodhya
sections.content:
(1) The area shall be deemed to include all assets, rights, leaseholds, powers, authority and privileges and all movable and immovable property, including lands, buildings, structures, shops or other properties and all other rights and interests, as were immediately before the commencement of this Act in the ownership, possession, power or control of any person or the State Government of Uttar Pradesh, together with all registers, maps, plans, drawings and other related documents.
(2) All such vested properties shall be freed and discharged from any trust, obligation, mortgage, charge, lien and all other encumbrances, and any attachment, injunction, decree or order of any court, tribunal or other authority restricting use of such properties or appointing a receiver shall cease to have effect.
(3) If, on commencement of this Act, any suit, appeal or other proceeding regarding right, title and interest in any vested property is pending before any court, tribunal or other authority, it shall abate.

sections.title: Duty of person or State Government in charge of the management of the area to deliver all assets, etc.
sections.chapter: Chapter II - Acquisition of the Area in Ayodhya
sections.content:
(1) The Central Government may take all necessary steps to secure possession of the area vested in it under section 3.
(2) On such vesting, the person or the State Government of Uttar Pradesh in charge of the management of the area immediately before vesting shall be bound to deliver to the Central Government or the authorised person all assets, registers and other documents relating to such vesting or, where delivery is impracticable, authenticated copies thereof in the prescribed manner.

sections.title: Power of Central Government to direct vesting of the area in another authority or body or trust
sections.chapter: Chapter II - Acquisition of the Area in Ayodhya
sections.content:
(1) Notwithstanding sections 3, 4, 5 and 7, the Central Government may, if satisfied that an authority, body or trustees of a trust set up on or after commencement is willing to comply with such terms and conditions as it may impose, direct by notification that the right, title and interest in relation to the area (or part thereof) vest in that authority, body or trustees, instead of continuing to vest in the Central Government, either from the date of notification or a later specified date.
(2) On such vesting, the Central Government's rights in relation to the area or part thereof shall be deemed to have become the rights of that authority, body or trustees.
(3) Sections 4, 5, 7 and 11 shall apply, so far as may be, to such authority, body or trustees as they apply to the Central Government, with references to the Central Government construed accordingly.

sections.title: Management of property by Government
sections.chapter: Chapter III - Management and Administration of Property
sections.content:
(1) Notwithstanding anything in any contract, instrument or court/tribunal order, on and from commencement of this Act, the property vested in the Central Government under section 3 shall be managed by the Central Government or by a person, body of persons or trustees of any trust authorised by that Government.
(2) In managing the property, the Central Government or authorised person shall ensure that the position existing before commencement of this Act, on the area on which the structure (including the premises of the inner and outer courtyards of such structure), commonly known as the Ram Janma Bhumi-Babri Masjid, stood in village Kot Ramchandra in Ayodhya, in Pargana Haveli Avadh, tehsil Faizabad Sadar, district Faizabad, Uttar Pradesh, is maintained.

sections.title: Payment of amount
sections.content:
(1) The owner of any land, building, structure or other property comprised in the area shall be given by the Central Government, for the transfer and vesting of such property under section 3, cash equivalent to its market value.
(2) The Central Government shall, for deciding claims of the owner or any person having a claim against the owner, by notification, appoint a Claims Commissioner.
(3) The Claims Commissioner shall regulate his own procedure for receiving and deciding claims.
(4) The owner or claimant may make a claim to the Claims Commissioner within ninety days of commencement of this Act: Provided that the Claims Commissioner may, if satisfied there was sufficient cause for delay, entertain the claim within a further ninety days and not thereafter.

sections.title: Act to override all other enactments
sections.content: The provisions of this Act shall have effect notwithstanding anything inconsistent therewith contained in any other law for the time being in force, or any instrument having effect by virtue of any law other than this Act, or any decree or order of any court, tribunal or other authority.

sections.title: Penalties
sections.content: Any person in charge of the management of the area who fails to deliver to the Central Government or the authorised person any asset, register or other document (or authenticated copies thereof) relating to the area shall be punishable with imprisonment up to three years, or fine up to ten thousand rupees, or both.

sections.title: Protection of action taken in good faith
sections.content: No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Central Government, the authorised person, or any of their officers or employees for anything done or intended to be done in good faith under this Act.

sections.title: Power to make rules
sections.content:
(1) The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, make rules to carry out the provisions of this Act.
(2) Every rule made shall be laid, as soon as may be, before each House of Parliament, while in session, for a total period of thirty days (which may be comprised in one or more sessions); if both Houses agree on modifications or that the rule should not be made, the rule shall thereafter have effect only in such modified form or be of no effect, without prejudice to anything previously done under it.

sections.title: Repeal and saving
sections.content:
(1) Subject to sub-section (2), the Acquisition of Certain Area at Ayodhya Ordinance, 1993 (Ord. 8 of 1993), is repealed.
(2) Notwithstanding the said Ordinance: (a) the right, title and interest in relation to plot No. 242 in village Kot Ramchandra (Sl. No. 1 of the Ordinance's Schedule) shall be deemed never to have been transferred to or vested in the Central Government; (b) any suit, appeal or proceeding regarding that plot pending before any court, tribunal or authority shall be deemed never to have abated, and shall be deemed restored to the position existing immediately before the Ordinance's commencement; (c) any other action taken under the Ordinance regarding that plot shall be deemed never to have been taken.
(3) Notwithstanding such repeal, anything done or action taken under the Ordinance shall be deemed to have been done or taken under the corresponding provisions of this Act.

sections.title: The Schedule — Description of the Area
sections.content: [See section 2(a)] Sets out the description of the acquired area by village, pargana, tehsil, district and State, and lists the revenue (Khasra) plot numbers and the corresponding area to be acquired (in Bigha-Biswa-Biswansi). The Schedule covers three villages in tehsil Faizabad Sadar, district Faizabad, Uttar Pradesh: (1) Village Kot Ramchandra, Pargana Haveli Avadh — plot numbers 143 to 246 (various, several as noted "part" plots with boundary descriptions), totalling approximately 75 bigha 14 biswa 7 biswansi; (2) Village Avadhkhas, Pargana Haveli Avadh — plot numbers 1104 to 1259 (various, including "part" plots with boundary descriptions), totalling approximately 27 bigha 0 biswa 11 biswansi; (3) Village Jalwanpur, Pargana Haveli Avadh — plot numbers 1 to 27, totalling approximately 9 bigha 7 biswa 15 biswansi. The full plot-by-plot Khasra listing with individual Bigha-Biswa-Biswansi measurements is set out in the official Gazette text of the Act and is not reproduced here in full detail.
